title: ReqIF mapping file
description: Mapping of the types and attributes of one ReqIF source to the own metamodel, saved as YAML in the mapping folder of the workspace (`mappings`, default `reqif` in the main repository) and reused for every later import from and export to that source (N-045, D-022, SR-054). The own metamodel is never changed by it (SR-054 AK3). Also holds saved export profiles (SR-059 AK3) and the source's own model, gathered by the imports through it (SR-158).

settings.description: The mapping without `source-model`: what `reqif.saveMapping` takes, since only `reqif.import` writes the source model.

source.description: The ReqIF source this mapping is for.

name.description: Name of the source as written to the property with meaning `source` (SR-057, D-059).

tool-id.description: REQ-IF-TOOL-ID seen in deliveries, for recognising the source.

target.description: Folder where imported elements are written.

types.description: Each SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE of the source, mapped to a type or omitted.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE.

omit.description: Objects of this type are not imported; each is listed as a loss.

attributes.description: Each ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION of the source, mapped to the title, the text or a property, or omitted.

source-type.description: Restricts the entry to one SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION.

property.description: Where the value goes: `title`, `text` or the key of a property.

omit-values.description: Enumeration values left out on import, each listed as a loss (SR-055 AK2).

omit.description: The attribute is not imported, which is listed as a loss.

relations.description: Each SPEC-RELATION-TYPE of the source, mapped to a relation kind or omitted.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the SPEC-RELATION-TYPE.

omit.description: Relations of this type are not imported.

statement.description: Where the statement goes when exporting back to the source (SR-058).

property.description: Own property that holds the statement.

datatype.description: How the statement is written: as STRING, or as XHTML converted from its Markdown (SR-058 AK1).

omit-properties.description: Properties left out of every export to this source; written by `reqif.export` with `mapping` and `omitProperties` (SR-059 AK1, AK3).

export-profiles.description: Saved exports to this source, each a selection under a name.

omit-properties.description: Properties left out of every export with this profile (SR-059 AK1).

sourceModel.description: The source's own model, gathered by the imports through this mapping (SR-158): the SPEC-OBJECT-TYPEs they mapped to a type, with their ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITIONs and the datatypes these use, each with IDENTIFIER and LONG-NAME and every facet as written in the file. Each import replaces the types of the `types` entries it delivers and keeps the others (ADR-0013 "Import"). Written only by `reqif.import` with `mapping`, never for a file of ReqSeq; `reqif.saveMapping` keeps it, unless `file` replaces the mapping of another source.

datatypes.description: The datatypes the attributes of `types` use.

long-name.description: Its LONG-NAME, when the file has one.

max-length.description: MAX-LENGTH of a STRING, as written.

min.description: MIN of an INTEGER or REAL, as written.

max.description: MAX of an INTEGER or REAL, as written.

accuracy.description: ACCURACY of a REAL, as written.

values.description: SPECIFIED-VALUES of an ENUMERATION, in the file's order.

long-name.description: Its LONG-NAME, when the file has one.

key.description: KEY of its EMBEDDED-VALUE, as written.

other-content.description: OTHER-CONTENT of its EMBEDDED-VALUE, as written.

types.description: The SPEC-OBJECT-TYPEs an import through this mapping mapped to a type, also those no `types` entry maps any more.

long-name.description: Its LONG-NAME, when the file has one.

attributes.description: Its ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITIONs, in the file's order, mapped or omitted.

long-name.description: Its LONG-NAME, when the file has one.

datatype.description: IDENTIFIER of its datatype, an entry of `datatypes`.

multi-valued.description: MULTI-VALUED of an enumeration attribute; left out when false.
